entities.name: Leo Skurnik
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Leo Skurnik was a Finnish physician, a medical officer in the Finnish Army and one of the three Finnish Jews who were proposed to be awarded the Iron Cross by Nazi Germany during World War II but refused to accept it.
